value.rationale: The uniform labelled weak-order model is a natural parameter sampling regime for a classical homogeneous poset; its one-point type search cost is exponentially large on possible skewed parameter sets yet has sharply quadratic average. The exact paired means distinguish raw model-theoretic types from symmetry-reduced search complexity, and the nontrivial limiting factor (log2)^-2 is an exact predictive normalization rather than an arbitrary finite case.
